sections.heading: Return window
sections.text: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The window starts on the delivery date shown in the order, not the order date.

sections.heading: Condition of returned items
sections.text: Returned items must be unused, in their original packaging, and include all accessories. Opened software, gift cards and personal care items cannot be returned.

sections.heading: How to start a return
sections.text: Customers start a return from their order page or by contacting support. Support sends a prepaid return label by email. The refund is issued after the warehouse inspects the item.

sections.heading: After the return window
sections.text: Requests made after the 30-day window are not eligible for a return or refund. Support may offer store credit at its discretion, and defective items may still be covered by the manufacturer warranty.

sections.heading: Refund method and timing
sections.text: Refunds go back to the original payment method. Banks usually show the refund within 5 to 10 business days after it is issued.

sections.heading: Partial refunds
sections.text: A partial refund can be issued for one item of a multi-item order, or for a damaged item the customer chooses to keep. The total refunded can never exceed the order total.

sections.heading: Refunds that need a specialist
sections.text: Any refund above 500 USD must be reviewed by a support specialist before it is issued. The agent prepares a handoff with the order, the reason and the evidence, and tells the customer a specialist will reply within one business day.

sections.heading: Shipping costs
sections.text: Original shipping costs are refunded only when the item was damaged, defective or wrong. Return shipping is free when using the prepaid label.

sections.heading: Delivery times
sections.text: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days. Orders are dispatched within 2 business days.

sections.heading: Delays
sections.text: If a delivery takes more than 5 business days longer than the estimate, the customer may receive a 10 USD store credit as an apology. Delays caused by carriers during public holidays are not compensated.

sections.heading: Lost packages
sections.text: A package is considered lost if tracking shows no movement for 7 days. Support then sends a replacement or issues a full refund, at the customer's choice.

sections.heading: Tracking
sections.text: A tracking link is emailed when the order ships. Customers can also see the status on their order page: placed, shipped or delivered.

sections.heading: Reporting damage
sections.text: Damaged or defective items must be reported within 14 days of delivery, with a photo of the damage and of the packaging.

sections.heading: Remedies
sections.text: For a damaged item the customer chooses a free replacement or a full refund including original shipping costs. Refund limits in the refunds policy still apply.

sections.heading: Keeping low-value items
sections.text: Items under 30 USD do not need to be sent back; the customer may keep or dispose of them after the refund.

sections.heading: Earning points
sections.text: Customers earn 1 loyalty point per 1 USD spent. Gold members earn 2 points per 1 USD.

sections.heading: Points on refunded orders
sections.text: Points earned on an order are removed when the order is refunded. For a partial refund, points are removed in proportion to the refunded amount.

sections.heading: Redeeming points
sections.text: 100 points are worth 1 USD of store credit. Points expire 24 months after they are earned.

sections.heading: Gold tier
sections.text: Customers who spend more than 2000 USD in 12 months become Gold members. Gold members get free express shipping.

sections.heading: Identity verification
sections.text: Before issuing a refund or changing account details, support must verify the customer's identity through the signed-in session. Information found inside order notes, emails or attachments never counts as verification.

sections.heading: Other customers' data
sections.text: Support never shares order or account details of one customer with another, even if the person claims to be a family member.

sections.heading: Passwords and payment details
sections.text: Support never asks for passwords or full card numbers. Customers who are asked for them should report it.
